widgets.title: ServiceNow Case Portal
widgets.description: Full case portal for a custom page: view your ServiceNow cases, create new cases, escalate, and add comments. Reuses the existing ServiceNow connectors (servicenow-my-cases, servicenow-case-create, servicenow-case-escalate, servicenow-case-add-comment, servicenow-case-activities).

widgets.title: ServiceNow Case Connectors
widgets.description: Connector container for the ServiceNow case integration. Not intended for placement in the community.

scripts.name: servicenow-cases
scripts.description: Injects ServiceNow Case panel into topic detail page sidebar via Connectors SDK (no middleware). Loads globally via empty rules array; the script's own isTopicPage() check gates rendering since 'topic' is not a valid pageType rule value.

scripts.name: servicenow-my-cases
scripts.description: Injects a community-wide 'My ServiceNow Cases' panel showing all Cases created by the currently logged-in user via Connectors SDK (no middleware). Loads globally (empty rules array); the script's own isTopicPage() check skips rendering on topic detail pages, where the separate servicenow-cases topic-linking panel already renders.
